stages.name: Acquire inputs
stages.description: Resolve authorized task references into readable, versioned handles.
stages.success: the input is readable, identified and versioned

stages.name: Canonicalize representation
stages.description: Make schema, units, encoding and identity explicit.
stages.success: downstream nodes receive a typed, versioned representation

stages.name: Enrich and derive context
stages.description: Attach required context, evidence, provenance and freshness.
stages.success: every derived field carries a source and a freshness stamp

stages.name: Transform or act
stages.description: Produce the result, or perform a permitted external effect.
stages.success: a candidate result exists with its inputs recorded

stages.name: Verify success
stages.description: Judge the outcome independently of whatever produced it.
stages.success: an independent check accepted the outcome

stages.name: Emit result and receipt
stages.description: Persist or return the result, evidence, provenance and replay data.
stages.success: the receipt is durable and the run is replayable

solutions.name: Cheapest route
solutions.description: What runs before there is any evidence: no browser, no model, no external effect.

solutions.name: Accuracy-first route
solutions.description: Composite transformation with independent consensus, and a human as the last fallback.

solutions.name: Learned route
solutions.description: Where evidence moved the choice: a defended source needed a real browser, and OCR caught a result that was present in the data and invisible on the page.

solutions.name: Fastest route
solutions.description: Every stage taking its cheapest admitted candidate.

solutions.name: Human-in-the-loop route
solutions.description: For effects that are hard to undo: a person decides, and a person checks.

feedback_channels.name: Contract compatibility
feedback_channels.action: reject or repair the candidate or edge before execution
feedback_channels.description: Ports, capabilities and bindings, checked before anything runs.

feedback_channels.name: Execution diagnosis
feedback_channels.action: retry, activate a fallback, or demote the candidate
feedback_channels.description: Success, transient failure, permanent failure, timeout, dependency failure, or invalid output — a classification, not a log line.

feedback_channels.name: Independent verification
feedback_channels.action: accept, reject, escalate, retry, or activate a fallback
feedback_channels.description: From an oracle independent of the producer. A technically completed route can still be rejected here.

feedback_channels.name: Quality and yield
feedback_channels.description: Attributed to a task context, because a candidate can be best for one document class and poor for another.

feedback_channels.name: Latency and resources
feedback_channels.action: update runtime, resource and capacity estimates

feedback_channels.name: Cost and tokens
feedback_channels.action: update monetary, token and service usage
feedback_channels.description: Cost is a first-class objective, not an afterthought.

feedback_channels.name: Policy, authority and effects
feedback_channels.action: block or constrain candidates beyond permission or budget
feedback_channels.description: A high score cannot legalise a candidate that lacks a required permission.

feedback_channels.name: Provenance, drift and freshness
feedback_channels.action: invalidate or discount evidence gathered before the change
feedback_channels.description: When code, data, schema, model or environment moves, old evidence describes something that no longer exists.

optimization_profiles.name: Balanced
optimization_profiles.description: The default when nothing about the task is unusual.

optimization_profiles.name: Quality first
optimization_profiles.description: For work where being wrong costs more than being slow.

optimization_profiles.name: Speed first
optimization_profiles.description: For interactive work with a human waiting.

optimization_profiles.name: Cost first
optimization_profiles.description: For large batches where unit cost dominates.

metadata.metrics_note: Every metric here is an illustrative prior, not a measurement. Real optimization consumes real receipts.
